messages:
maria: Quick sync — Predictor GA readiness. Need alignment on SLA targets, docs owner, support rota, monitoring dashboards, and pricing slug. Can we do a rapid pass?
ajay: timeline? we aiming for end of month? :eyes:
maría: yes EOM is the target. small scope, staged rollout.
liz: I can own docs + examples. will need sample prompts and error-mode behavior.
ajay: SLA proposal: hosted: 99.95 uptime, P95 latency <250ms; dedicated: 99.9 uptime, P95 <500ms. fallback policy to smaller model if overloaded. thoughts?
samir: numbers look ok but we need clear degraded-mode SLOs (e.g., increased latency but correctness preserved). propose: if cost-saving fallback triggers >1% traffic, auto-rollback.
maria: agree on degraded SLOs. add an alert when fallback >0.5% for 15m. ops-bot: [alert rule created] predictor.fallback.rate > 0.5% for 15m -> #eng-oncall.
nathan: support rota? I can be primary for first two weeks of rollout, then hand to platform oncall. need runbook link.
liz: docs draft ETA 48h. will put README + troubleshooting + known-limits. adding section: "What to expect during scaled bursts".
ajay: pricing slug: start with tiered per-token + fixed minimal monthly for dedicated. draft: predictor.standard = $0.0008/token gen; predictor.dedicated = reserved CPU/GPU tier pricing. open to numbers.
maria: product needs $/request matrix too for small prompts (we care about tail-case pricing). can you sketch sample contracts for enterprise?
ajay: will pull examples. also need telemetry hooks in request payload for customer id + route. privacy OK?
samir: add opt-out param for telemetry; default on for enterprise. ensure PII never logged. security signoff required.
liz: doc checklist: quickstart, sdk examples, error codes, SLO table, rollback steps, customer-facing SLA summary. I'll create PR and tag @maria @nathan.
maria: decision items: (1) accept SLA numbers above, (2) docs owner = liz, (3) support rota initial = nathan, (4) pricing draft = ajay, (5) alert thresholds + runbook = samir. thumbs? :thumbsup:
ajay: +1
liz: +1
samir: +1
nathan: +1
maria: I'll schedule a 20m shiproom tomorrow to lock final wording, update tickets, and cut the pricing proposal. thanks all.
ops-bot: deploy-preview: predictor-v0.9 -> staging started by maria at 1829004465
ajay: staging smoke plan: load test 50k reqs/min, validate fallback behavior and billing tags. anyone want to join run?
samir: I'll run the load test at 14:00 PT. posting results to thread.
maria: perfect — capture p95, fallback rate, error rates, and billing tags. we'll reconvene after results.
